analysis.title: Market Rhythm
key_insights: Russell 3000 reclaimed the broken uptrend but stalled at the declining 50dma. Breadth is still weak, without the breakaway price and breadth momentum seen in early April.

Dow Jones Industrial Average has grinded higher along a clean October uptrend but struggles to clear the falling 50dma. Short-term oscillators are overbought, so the move risks forming a lower high versus August.
Nasdaq 100 futures look oversold and could bounce, but price is below the broken trendline with no real momentum and difficulty retesting the falling 50dma. The setup is not V-shaped.

Philadelphia Semiconductors bounced off the 200dma from deeply oversold October levels, but the rebound is mild. Resistance sits at 11,355 (gap), around 11,750 (broken trendline) and 11,923 (falling 50dma).

KOSPI rose 3% today, which barely changed the chart. Oversold conditions can fuel more relief, but resistance is heavy: 5,810 range high, 5,945 and 6,368 gaps, 6,464 at the 200dma and 6,569 at the 50dma.
DAX held above the 200dma and printed a higher low, unlike Euro Stoxx 50. It is capped by a declining 50dma near 25,600 and remains in a broader downtrend range.
Silver (XAGUSD, 54.00) broke below the trendline around 54.80/75, confirming a short-term bearish bias. A daily close below 53.30 opens a move toward 51.00, and rebounds should be capped near 58.00.
EURJPY (176.10) is just above 175.00 support, reinforced by the 100-week moving average near 174.95. A clean break below opens a final downside target in the 174.00-172.00 region.

sector_views.rationale: Mild rebound from the 200dma after deeply oversold October levels, facing multiple resistance levels.
